description: This source file implements a CameraCaptureService actor for macOS, providing functionalities such as listing camera devices, taking snapshots, and recording/clip video clips. It manages camera access, device selection, and media export, leveraging AVFoundation for media operations.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Handles photo capture callbacks, delivering photo data or errors to the awaiting continuation.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Manages recording delegate callbacks, handling completion or errors during video recording.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their IDs, names, positions, and types.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo using specified camera options, returns image data and size.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with given parameters, saves it to a file, and returns its path, duration, and audio info.
